en.title: Join us for the Energy Drinks event on 8 and 15 January 2025!
en.summary: Join us on January 8 and 15, 2025, for two evenings of presentations and games about renewable energy!
en.image_alt: Join us for the Energy Drinks event on 8 and 15 January 2025!
en.body:
**Join us on January 8 and 15, 2025, for two evenings of presentations and games about renewable energy!**

**What?**  
Each evening will feature 3 to 4 presentations on current energy topics in Switzerland. After each presentation, there will be a game that everyone is welcome to join! Prizes will be awarded to the winners of each game: t-shirts, solar chargers, tote bags...

**When?**  
Two events are planned, from 6 PM to 9 PM:

**\- January 8, 2025**: _"100% renewable energy in Switzerland: Is it possible?"_

**\- January 15, 2025**: _"Do we need alpine photovoltaics in Switzerland?"_  
Feel free to attend both events!

**Where?**  
The downstairs room at **Café Gavroche**, reserved especially for the occasion.  
Address: Café Gavroche, Boulevard James-Fazy 4, 1201 Geneva

**Who can attend?**  
Everyone is welcome, whether you come alone or with friends. The event is open to all, even those with no prior knowledge of renewable energy!

**In what language?  
**The presentations will be in French and English. Even if you don’t speak one of the two languages, we’ll be there to help you!

**Organized by?**  
The event is organized by EDGE, a SWEET consortium sponsored by the Swiss Federal Office of Energy, bringing together researchers from around ten Swiss universities.

**Registration?**  
No registration is required, but we encourage you to arrive by 6 PM to secure your spot.
